toml:
# LEO-PNT vertical: polar and Arctic users.
#
# GNSS medium Earth orbit (MEO) planes are inclined 55 to 56 deg, so from the Arctic every
# GNSS satellite sits in the southern half of the sky at low elevation, and the vertical
# geometry suffers. A polar low Earth orbit (LEO) constellation passes overhead there
# most often. A user travels north through three phases of an hour each, Tromso (69.7 N),
# Longyearbyen on Svalbard (78.2 N) and the North Pole drift ice (89.5 N); each phase runs
# a `leo-pvt` joint fix of GPS and Galileo, with and without the Iridium constellation (the
# public `iridium-stl` preset: 66 satellites at 780 km, 86.4 deg, with its representative
# 5 m signal-in-space range error), and a `leo-pass` run of the three highest Iridium
# passes of a quarter hour over the site, whose geometry the campaign exports.
#
# Channels: the GNSS-only and fused 3D errors, their position dilution of precision
# (PDOP) and the satellites in view. The alarm is raised where the fused error exceeds
# 3 m. `polar-arctic-leo-coverage` gives the same comparison as a table over latitude.
#
# MODELLED: two-body orbits with J2 from each constellation preset; no ionospheric
# scintillation, which the auroral zone would add.
kind = "campaign"
title = "Polar and Arctic users with a polar LEO layer"
seed = 20260929

[timeline]
step_s = 60.0

[[phases]]
name = "tromso"
duration_s = 3600.0

[[phases.runs]]
series = [
  { channel = "gnss_error_m", unit = "m", t = "joint.epochs[].t_s", y = "joint.epochs[].error_gnss_m" },
  { channel = "position_error_m", t = "joint.epochs[].t_s", y = "joint.epochs[].error_fused_m" },
  { channel = "pdop_gnss", unit = "1", t = "joint.epochs[].t_s", y = "joint.epochs[].pdop_gnss" },
  { channel = "pdop_fused", unit = "1", t = "joint.epochs[].t_s", y = "joint.epochs[].pdop_fused" },
  { channel = "gnss_in_view", unit = "count", t = "joint.epochs[].t_s", y = "joint.epochs[].n_gnss" },
  { channel = "leo_in_view", unit = "count", t = "joint.epochs[].t_s", y = "joint.epochs[].n_leo" },
]
alarms = [{ channel = "position_error_m", compare = "above", threshold = 3.0 }]
[phases.runs.scenario]
kind = "leo-pvt"
mode = "joint"
seed = 4
duration_s = 3600.0
step_s = 60.0
[phases.runs.scenario.user]
lat_deg = 69.65
lon_deg = 18.96
height_m = 20.0
[[phases.runs.scenario.system]]
name = "GPS"
preset = "gps-baseline"
cn0_dbhz = [38.0, 48.0]
sisre_m = 0.6
mask_deg = 10.0
[[phases.runs.scenario.system]]
name = "Galileo"
preset = "galileo"
cn0_dbhz = [38.0, 48.0]
sisre_m = 0.3
isb_ns = 12.0
mask_deg = 10.0
[[phases.runs.scenario.system]]
name = "Iridium"
leo_preset = "iridium-stl"
isb_ns = 30.0
mask_deg = 10.0

[[phases.runs]]
series = [
  { channel = "iridium_pass_elevation_deg", unit = "deg", t = "satellites[0].series[].t_s", y = "satellites[0].series[].elevation_deg" },
]
[phases.runs.scenario]
kind = "leo-pass"
name = "Iridium pass, tromso"
epoch = "2026-09-28T08:00:00"
duration_s = 900.0
step_s = 10.0
[phases.runs.scenario.user]
environment = "ground"
lat_deg = 69.65
lon_deg = 18.96
height_m = 20.0
mask_deg = 10.0
[[phases.runs.scenario.leo_constellation]]
system = "iridium-stl"
max_satellites = 3
[phases.runs.scenario.gnss]
constellation = "gps-baseline"
band = "L1"

name = "svalbard"
